resources.string: This app is a native recompilation of %1$s (Xbox 360, Title ID %2$s). It contains no game data.\n\nDrop in YOUR copy: tap \"Choose ISO / default.xex\" and pick the game\'s disc image (.iso) or its default.xex, or pick an already-extracted folder. The files are unpacked into this app\'s own storage – no special permissions needed. Any other game is refused.
